name: followers-overview
title: Followers Overview
description: Follow notifications flip through in 3D, one name at a time, then the total follower count blurs in with a spring pop, the account handle and a confetti burst.
useWhen: A milestone or social-proof scene needs cycling follow notifications that build to a total reveal.
You want a confetti-backed audience count as the payoff of a growth story.
Several recent followers should be shown, not a single profile.
avoidWhen: You are highlighting one profile and a follow click: use profile-follow-card.
The scene needs a count-up with a list fly-through: use milestone-counter-list.
You only need a bare count-up with no feed or confetti: use rolling-number.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Notifications
variables.description: Semicolon-separated entries "Name|time|v"; add |v to show a check mark after the name.
variables.default: Maya Lindqvist|7h|v; Jonas Reyes|7h|v; marcus|8h; Lena Okoro|9h|v; dev_jay|10h; Priya Nair|11h|v; Tomas Brandt|13h|v; hana.k|15h; Will Archer|18h|v; Yuki Mori|21h|v; benoit|23h; Amara Diallo|1d|v; Leo Martins|1d|v; sol|2d

variables.label: Event text
variables.description: Text after the name; the entry's time follows it.

variables.label: Total
variables.description: Follower total revealed at the end.

variables.label: Handle
variables.description: Account handle shown above the total (an @ is added). Leave empty to hide the account.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Colour of the check marks and the first confetti colour.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the scene sits over your own footage.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed multiplier; above 1 the scene plays faster and holds the end.
